_help: Settings for the Riftbound price tracker. Percentages are plain numbers (15 = 15%). Prices are in EUR.
_movers_min_price: Cards cheaper than this are left out of the 'biggest movers' lists (cheap cards jump 50% on a few cents).
_watchlist_alerts: Alert for a watchlist card when its trend price moves at least this much in 1 day or over 7 days (up or down).
_all_cards_alerts: Also alert for ANY card worth at least min_price that moves pct_1d in a single day. Set enabled to false to turn off.
_card_images: Download card pictures, set, rarity and card number from OpenRift (openrift.app) each day.
_expansions: Optional: give Cardmarket expansion ids a readable name, e.g. "6286": "Origins". The dashboard shows 'Set <id>' until you do.
